headline: This law caps the aviation passenger security fee at $11.20 per round trip.
what_it_does: It changes the rules for the aviation passenger security fee, which is charged to people who fly. Under the measure, the total fee for a round trip cannot exceed $11.20. The official summary describes only this cap, so details such as how the fee is collected or spent are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Air travelers who pay the aviation passenger security fee
who_it_affects.how: The total security fee on a round trip is limited to $11.20.
They are subject to the revised fee requirements for the passengers they carry.
